class.name: AssetTagRegistry
class.brief_description: Reverse index of asset paths by tag.
class.description: Stores and queries per-asset tag assignments for editor search and MCP tools.

method.name: abort_batch
method.description: Discards the active index batch without persisting pending path changes.

method.name: add_tags_to_asset
method.description: Adds [param tags] to the asset at [param path]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the update fails.

method.name: asset_matches_tag_filter
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the asset at [param path] matches [param tag_tokens]. When [param require_all] is [code]true[/code], every token must match.

method.name: begin_batch
method.description: Starts a nested index batch so multiple asset tag mutations can be committed together.

method.name: cancel_opened_batch
method.description: Aborts every nested open batch and restores the previous index state.

method.name: commit_batch
method.description: Ends one batch level and persists dirty index paths when the outermost batch closes. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if saving fails.

method.name: find_assets_by_tag
method.description: Returns asset paths tagged with [param tag]. When [param match_parent] is [code]true[/code], hierarchical children of [param tag] also match.

method.name: get_indexed_paths
method.description: Returns every asset path currently present in the tag index.

method.name: get_tags_for_asset
method.description: Returns the tags assigned to the asset at [param path].

method.name: get_unused_tags
method.description: Returns dictionary tags that are not assigned to any indexed asset.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the asset tag index from disk. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the index cannot be read.

method.name: prune_removed_paths
method.description: Immediately removes index entries whose asset paths no longer exist on disk.

method.name: remove_tags_from_asset
method.description: Removes [param tags] from the asset at [param path]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the update fails.

method.name: rename_asset_path
method.description: Moves indexed tags from [param old_path] to [param new_path]. Returns [code]true[/code] when the path was remapped.

method.name: rescan
method.description: Rebuilds the reverse lookup from the current index and persists it. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if saving fails.

method.name: save
method.description: Persists the asset tag index to disk. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if writing fails.

method.name: schedule_prune_removed_paths
method.description: Schedules a debounced call to [method prune_removed_paths].

method.name: search_assets
method.description: Searches indexed assets by [param tags] with optional type and path filters. Returns a result dictionary containing matching paths and metadata.

method.name: set_tags_for_asset
method.description: Replaces all tags on the asset at [param path] with [param tags]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an [enum Error] if the update fails.

signal.name: asset_tags_batch_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a batch commit with the list of asset [param paths] whose tags changed.

signal.name: asset_tags_changed
signal.description: Emitted when tags change for a single asset [param path] outside a batch.

signal.name: index_reloaded
signal.description: Emitted when the asset tag index is reloaded from disk.
